newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar, weaker on pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee was fixed firmer against the dollar but weakened versus the pound on Tuesday, commercial bank forex dealers said.
The rupee was posted at a mean commercial rate of 19.904 against the dollar from 19.911 on Monday. The rupee was quoted at a mean of 33.6625 to the pound from 33.6425 on Monday.
Forex dealers said the rupee's fixing reflected overnight international trends as there was nothing on the local front.
"Everything is quiet in the local forex market with hardly any activity at all," one dealer said. "What else can be expected on New Year's Eve?"
